flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi (cronservice): services/datahive/nricFinUenDataRetrieval/{service/DataHiveUENBatchService,dto/UENDataResult}; workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService (storeUenDataResult, updateShareholderInfo, updateBoardInfo which is not called, addRecordsToNroTemp); cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no RD1/RD2 decision code for director/owner.
note: The story asks OCMS to receive the owner/partner/director particulars by date of offence and appointment period, then decide whether the NOPO goes back for the 1st reminder to the Director/Partner or the 2nd reminder to the Owner/Partner. What exists: the DataHive response (company, shareholder, board) is received and parsed. What does not: picking persons by offence date/appointment and the RD1 vs RD2 decision; after storing, the notice is only recorded in ocms_nro_temp (noticeNo only) and no stage or offender changes. Board data is deliberately not written to DB (comment OCMS-DEV-2026-231; updateBoardInfo exists but its call is disabled at DataHiveUenFinService.java:1470-1477). The job is off in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:52). DataHive response content and vault: cannot verify from repo. Sheet status: Demo paid (50% of 75%). No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim in full. Only receiving the DataHive response exists; selection by offence date/appointment, storing the person data, and the RD1 vs RD2 decision are missing. Ask URA to confirm whether it was built elsewhere or mark a gap.

steps.step: OCMS receives the response for the company UEN (found, de-registered or not found)
steps.detail: batchRetrieveUENData merges the company, shareholder and board results per UEN+notice pair (DataHiveUENBatchService.java:66-71, :128-215); storeUenDataResult handles errors, UEN not found and de-registered (DataHiveUenFinService.java:1346-1362). Lowered because the job is off in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:52) and the real response content: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Owner/partner/director particulars are received (ID, position, appointment and withdrawn dates)
steps.detail: The board response is parsed into BoardInfo with personIdNo, positionHeldCode, positionAppointmentDate, positionWithdrawnDate and referencePeriod (DataHiveUENBatchService.java:483-502, UENDataResult.java:88-101). There is no person name or address, so the particulars are not complete enough to post a letter. Same fit as OCMS11.19 and OCMS11.20 step 1.

steps.step: Only persons in office at the date of offence (appointment period) are selected
steps.detail: There is no date filter. The board query has no date (DataHiveUENBatchService.java:432-442), UenNoticeData has no offence date (UenNoticeData.java:15-27), and the appointment/withdrawn dates are only copied into the DTO (UENDataResult.java:94-100) without being compared with notice_date_and_time. Grep for appointment/director/partner across the six repos finds only those DTO fields. Same as OCMS11.17 step 5.

steps.step: Particulars of the selected persons are stored in OCMS
steps.detail: Shareholders are stored through updateShareholderInfo (DataHiveUenFinService.java:1440-1447), but a shareholder is not a director/partner by appointment period. Board data is only logged; updateBoardInfo exists (:1877-1900) but its call is commented out (:1470-1477, OCMS-DEV-2026-231), so board data is not stored. Only part of what the story needs is stored.

steps.step: OCMS decides: 1st reminder to Director/Partner or 2nd reminder to Owner/Partner
steps.detail: There is no decision branch. After storeUenDataResult finishes, the notice is only inserted into ocms_nro_temp with noticeNo alone (DataHiveUenFinService.java:955-968, addRecordsToNroTemp :916-925) and the method returns true (:1479-1485) without changing next_processing_stage, offender or recipient. The UEN flow has no RD1/RD2 reference apart from the selection query.
